stem: Which sequence best supports a routine irrigation verification?
choices: Confirm work order and zone, observe system startup, verify representative delivery/output, inspect root-zone response, and record deviations
Start irrigation, leave the area, and record the programmed volume as delivered
Change timing first, then check the work order
Measure one convenient emitter and assume the whole room is identical
rationale: Verification should connect the work order to actual system operation, measured delivery, crop/root-zone response, and documentation.
